posts.author: Cherry
posts.body:
The empty space is just there because the miss message field is not that wide as you can only use a short text within it anyway.
The game you posted probably used DynRPG, the DLL is likely a DynRPG plugin calling the
RPG::Battler::damagePopup
function with a custom text. Unfortunately you can't use that though because DynRPG is not compatible with the official English release!
What is your current setup, are you using Maniac or not? If not, I might be able to help here in some way and provide a custom solution, if you tell me in what way/circumstances you'd like to show a custom popup text.

posts.author: Cherry
posts.body:
I have an idea how I could make it very simple for me to patch, hopefully.
Do you use the "MP percentage cost" option for any of your skills?
If not: My idea is to "abuse" this field so you can put a number there (even if the skill is otherwise configured to a fixed MP cost - because the value in the percentage field is still stored in the skill!) which is actually interpreted as the ID of an actor. Then, the name of the specified actor will be used instead of "Miss".
So for example, you would put there "34" and then name actor #34 "Unaffected".
(Caveat: This will crash if an invalid actor ID is referenced, so make sure to set it to a meaningful ID in all your skills!)
Let me know if that works for you. If yes, I'll proceed making a patch.

posts.author: Cherry
posts.body:
Here you go:
https://cherryshare.at/f/G6ESg0/RPG_RT_DynamicMissMessage.ips
Use a tool like "Lunar IPS" to apply. (Select "All Files" to find the RPG_RT.exe file.) Double-check you are using the official engine (not editor) version v1.12a and make a backup of your project first!
Visual explanation of the feature:
"Sounds weird how that works" - well, it may sound weird but it's the easiest way for me to do it because the change required was small enough to be able to fit into the space otherwise used by the instructions that looked up the "Miss" string. I was looking for an otherwise unused numerical field in the skill and that's how I landed at MP percentage. I knew there was no unused
text
field so I had to use some other text field indexable by a number, which is why I used actor names.
Originally I thought actor names would also be nice because they can be changed dynamically, but now I realized it was too complicated to allow those changed ones - instead, this patch will always look at the name the referenced actor has in the database, so even if you use "Change Actor Name" it won't be reflected here.
Please note that
the maximum string length is still 8
, like it is in the field where you can set the original "Miss!" string, so "Unaffected" is too long, it will show as "Unaffect"! But "Failed" works for example.
By the way, one other thing you might want to take into account: There is a hidden variable that defines whether a skill is "physical" or not. The evasion sound will play only for physical skills when missed, and it also affects which formula is used to calculate the miss probability. (That this is hidden is a bug, but it will likely never be fixed.) You can use this tool here to see and change whether a skill is physical or not:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/skill-as-physical-skill.172165/post-1472424
